envelope.description: Rewrite jetbrains-plugin's three affected test files to assert the corrected update routing

body.title: Rewrite jetbrains-plugin's three affected test files to assert the corrected update routing
body.summary: Rewrite DaemonProvisionerTest.kt, DefaultDaemonScriptLocatorTest.kt and DaemonLifecycleCommandRunnerTest.kt so none of them exercise the removed legacy/existingUpgradeTarget() branch; each asserts UPDATE always spawns daemon-ctl.sh update for an unmanaged install, matching t3's new behavior, with INSTALL coverage unchanged.
acceptanceChecks: All three rewritten test files pass against t3's implementation and fail if the legacy branch or existingUpgradeTarget() is reintroduced.

tests.name: jetbrains-plugin/src/test/kotlin/ai/insors/insrc/jetbrains/lifecycle/DefaultDaemonScriptLocatorTest.kt (rewritten: existingUpgradeTarget() assertions removed if the method is deleted, or updated to always-null if retained for interface compatibility)

jetbrains-plugin/src/test/kotlin/ai/insors/insrc/jetbrains/lifecycle/DaemonLifecycleCommandRunnerTest.kt (rewritten: the legacy branch it currently exercises via INSRC_ROUTE_MATRIX_* env vars is removed)
